x: Laurie and Leo ran well but both admitted that the London Marathon of the previous week must have slowed them. Nonetheless we turned in our best time for 4 years and had Croydon, Blackheath and Brighton behind us.

Aided by Marco, Ollie Foote, Jacqui and Jackie (and we have seen Leo doing a bit of spud peeling), Marcello is putting a lot of heart into activities at our headquarters and deserves our full support.

Leo's been at it again. No sooner is the season over than he is finding new ways to work out where the points went.
